caption: The drawing depicts a single, dark-colored object resembling an insect with detailed body segments and patterned textures, shown in three different views. The main depiction is a three-quarters perspective of the object, showing a textured body with rounded, raised patterns, six short, rounded legs, and two long, curved antennae extending forward. The object has a segmented body, with distinct sections for the head, thorax, and abdomen. Above this main drawing, there are two additional line drawings: one showing a top-down view and another from the side. Each of these simplified outlines corresponds to the same object, revealing the arrangement of body parts and appendages more clearly. A scale bar in inches is included beneath the line drawings for reference. The entire composition is set against a light, plain background, and the artist's name, "H. BADER," appears in the lower right corner. The drawing is in grayscale with shading techniques used to suggest three-dimensional form and surface texture.
title: Bootjack
